answer: Hardware-rooted enrollment: each identity submits a TPM endorsement certificate, and an attestation verifier validates the quote against the vendor CA before that vertex of the trust graph is written. Detection rule: two identities sharing an endorsement key or chip batch are voided together and their sponsor bonds slashed. A counterfeit chip costs $4 at volume, but each fake also needs a board and rack slot, so 5,000 fakes cost near $60,000 plus 5,000 seats. Honest enrollment buys one onyx chip once; a sybil farm must mint copper into silicon, not text.
